verdict.rationale: Sketch explicitly ships a built-in local MCP server letting AI clients like ChatGPT/Claude connect and pull design context, plus AI features that recreate frames, text styles, colors and components with 1:1 fidelity from a repo — directly matching the agent-design story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the MCP server reliably exposes frames, variables and screenshots (all evidence is vendor docs), and no explicit documentation of a 'variables' or 'screenshot' API endpoint distinct from general AI features.
